chunks: It will throw out sparks as [large] as a castle.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean when it says the fire throws sparks like a castle?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this vivid imagery of sparks resembling castles underscores the overwhelming magnitude of divine retribution, often linked to the concept of *'Adab al-Din* (discipline of religion) where the scale of punishment matches the magnitude of sin. Scholars such as Al-Tabarsi highlight this comparison to emphasize that the torment is not merely physical but reflects the colossal weight of the sinner's deeds, serving as a deterrent for the faithful.
